name: George Smith
role: Medora horseman in charge at Sully creek ranch, 1884
bio: George Smith gave curiosities to the Cow Boy's museum in February 1884 and was badly bitten by the Kentucky stallion that May, when he was also put in charge of the stock horses at Sully creek ranch. In July 1884 he narrowly escaped injury when a team of broncos he was holding ran away toward the Cow Boy office.
